composition_contract.errors: Authored callback failures retain all prior writes/calls; unsupported address/work/shape bounds are independent native-only tests.
composition_contract.memory: All sparse backing bytes including explicit zeros; complete store/write/call histories and interleaved model events. Callback pokes and successful callback results retain call ordinal. Callback lists and tuples carry explicit shape tags; native Vec3 maps to the original tuple; buffer tokens retain the original tuple/string/bytes structure.
composition_contract.publication: Sibling temporary files flushed and fsynced, fixture replaced then manifest last. Interrupted pair publication is detectable by hashes; not a two-file transaction.
composition_contract.references: Only git-show immutable source with SHA256 verification; no helper imports or native outputs.
composition_contract.rng: Water entry executes original object generator. Shared seed remains an independently observed raw memory word; Model.draws retains shared draw count.
composition_contract.scope: Original pinned Creature_moveBy, water bookkeeping and settle; explicit authored terrain/contact/virtual/resource/sound callbacks. No original service implementation or Session/player/controller binding.
